name: Page shell, nav, menu, hours and location
purpose: No page exists: no nav, menu, hours or location sections.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if the file lacks viewport meta or any #menu, #hours or #location anchor after the first pass, or if calls exceed 3.

completion_check: File has viewport meta, at least one @media breakpoint, nav links to #menu #hours #location #preorder #gallery #farms, menu with at least 2 categories, hours and location sections present, every unknown value visibly marked as placeholder.

name: Pickup pre-order builder
purpose: Visitors cannot build an order or get a summary to send.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if the summary does not contain items, quantities and pickup time after the first pass, or if calls exceed 2.

completion_check: Item quantities update a visible total or list, a pickup time field exists, a Generate summary button produces text containing items, quantities and pickup time, and send channel and time rules are marked placeholders.

name: Large photo gallery

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if fewer than 12 slots or any slot lacks alt text or loading=lazy after the first pass.

completion_check: Count of gallery img or slot elements is at least 12; each has non-empty alt and loading=lazy; each is visibly marked as placeholder.

name: Three farm stories

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if there are not exactly 3 entries, or any farm fact appears that is not a marked placeholder.

completion_check: Exactly 3 farm entries, each containing name, location, story and photo slot elements; all values visibly marked placeholder; no invented farm facts.
